summary.intent: Investigate TEE-worker/sdk-e2e test skip behavior and republish queue state, then clean up dead code and fix bugs found along the way in the cipher-box monorepo (packages/sdk and apps/web).
summary.outcome: Fixed a zeroization-order bug in enumerateMoveDescendants (packages/sdk/src/client.ts), added and red-green-verified a regression test, removed dead code from share.service.ts and useMutationFailureUx.ts, discovered web vitest isn't wired into CI and an ipns.service test failure that appears pre-existing on main, filed three todo files for deferred issues, and committed the SDK fix with its test.

repo: tee-worker's running container must be located via container labels to find its compose file, then rebuilt from current source to pick up code changes — it isn't auto-synced.
apps/web's vitest suite is not invoked anywhere in ci.yml, so failures there (e.g. ipns.service.test) can go unnoticed by CI.
share.service.ts and useMutationFailureUx.ts contained dead code (e.g. ensureFreshSentShares path) referenced only in comments with zero real importers.

ipns.service.test failure reproduces identically on main with the same file structure, suggesting it's a pre-existing/environmental issue unrelated to this session's changes rather than something introduced by the diff.

code.finding: enumerateMoveDescendants had an ordering bug around key zeroization; fixed and covered by a new regression test.
New regression test added for the moveItem/enumerateMoveDescendants zeroization-order bug; confirmed it fails against the unfixed code (red) and passes after the fix (green).
Multiple dead code spans removed after confirming no external code references (only stale comments referenced them).
Dead code removed after confirming no remaining usages.

workflow: To validate a new regression test actually catches the bug, temporarily revert the fix and confirm the test goes red, then reapply and confirm green.
When a test failure looks suspicious, diff the suspect file against main and swap in main's version to isolate whether the failure predates the current changes.
Deferred/non-blocking issues get filed as dated markdown files in .planning/todos/pending/ rather than fixed inline.

friction: Significant time spent chasing the ipns.service.test failure (comparing imports, mocks, and api-config module scope against main) without reaching a definitive root cause before concluding it's likely pre-existing.
Locating the tee-worker's compose definition required finding it via running container labels rather than a direct file path — not discoverable.

Tracing the TEE test renewal mechanism and republish queue state (BullMQ/redis) required multiple rounds of log and code inspection before the actual investigation could proceed to the dead-code and bug-fix work.
open_items: web vitest is not run in CI, and the ipns.service.test failure remains unresolved — filed as .planning/todos/pending/2026-07-02-web-vitest-not-in-ci-and-ipns-service-test-broken.md
write03 refresh-access path has no live trigger — filed as .planning/todos/pending/2026-07-02-write03-refresh-access-path-has-no-live-trigger.md
Dead SDK share scaffolding should be retired — filed as .planning/todos/pending/2026-07-02-retire-dead-sdk-share-scaffolding.md
